findings.issue: No test script and no test runner installed, despite Qwik shipping first-party Vitest support (npm run qwik add vitest) and the starter scaffolding already ignoring *.spec.ts(x)
findings.suggestion: Add vitest + @builder.io/qwik/testing and a test script; the pure helpers in src/lib/format.ts need no mocking at all

findings.issue: Pure, spec-critical helpers (humanize, dexNumber, idFromUrl, lastEnglishEntry, cleanText, orDash, title) are untested — the cheapest, highest-value unit targets in the codebase
findings.suggestion: Write table-driven tests from the SPEC.md definitions, e.g. humanize('mr-mime') → 'Mr Mime', orDash(0) → '0', orDash(null) → '—'

findings.issue: Alternate-form cutoff (id < 10000) and per-id dedup in cardsForPokemon are untested; a regression re-admits Mega forms or duplicates cards on type/move/ability pages
findings.suggestion: Unit test cardsForPokemon against a speciesById map with IDs 25, 386 and 10033 (deoxys-normal)

findings.issue: Moves aggregation — default version group (groups.at(-1)), the `${method}:${level}` dedup key, and method rank ordering — is complex and untested
findings.suggestion: Extract the aggregation into a testable function in src/lib and cover default-game selection, ?game override, and method ordering

findings.issue: Cache semantics untested: 404s are negatively cached for 60s, failures evict via value.catch, and cache.clear() drops everything past 5000 entries
findings.suggestion: Test the cache with a stubbed fetch: 404 → null and cached, rejected promise removed from cache, TTL expiry refetches

findings.issue: Page clamping and URL-default omission in listUrl/index (page=999, page=0, NaN, empty q) are only guarded by two acceptance fixtures
findings.suggestion: Unit test listUrl and the clamping arithmetic directly — both are pure functions

findings.issue: Sort comparator (missing-last in both directions, name tie-break, direction flip, aria-sort) untested; acceptance tests only click Power on one table
findings.suggestion: Extract the comparator to src/lib and test ascending/descending with null power/accuracy/level values

findings.issue: go() reads current filter values from the DOM via form.elements.namedItem('type'|'generation'); renaming a form field silently breaks filter navigation and no test would notice
findings.suggestion: Hold filter state in signals instead of scraping the form, and add a test for 'changing type keeps the search term'

findings.issue: Sparse slot indexing (slots[entry.slot - 1] then filter(Boolean)) can silently shift type slot order if a slot-1 entry is missing
findings.suggestion: Test speciesIndex with synthetic type data covering slots {1,2}, {2} and {1}

findings.issue: api() throws on any non-2xx and apiOrThrow on generation details turns one failed sub-fetch into a 500 for the whole list page; no error-path coverage
findings.suggestion: Add a graceful fallback in speciesIndex for failed generation fetches and a test with a failing endpoint

summary: The app shipped no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no spec files — leaving its dense data-transformation layer (formatting helpers, alternate-form filtering, moves aggregation, sorting, pagination, caching) guarded only by the acceptance fixtures. Most of that logic is pure and trivially unit-testable, and Qwik's official Vitest integration would have made adding it a one-command setup. As a PR into a codebase we'll own for years, this is the dimension most in need of follow-up work.
